Victory in the February Stakes. Her 
declaration of "1st place in everything" 
is off to a successful start with this 
first win.

Everyone around is thrilled by the smooth 
start. Yet Smart Falcon herself remains 
uncharacteristically, unnervingly calm...

Her next target: June's Teio Sho. Without 
letting success go to her head, Smart 
Falcon set her sights on the next victory.
